title: Some[Body] Must Receive That Pain for Agent Accountability
reasoning: The paper is a philosophical and theoretical inquiry into the ethics of AI accountability. It analyzes AI agency through canonical ethical theories of punishment (deterrence, rehabilitation, retribution, and incapacitation) and explores the 'moral status' and potential 'suffering' of AI agents. It also discusses the concept of 'moral crumple zones' regarding human responsibility for AI failures.
